# Anastasiia Pirus

> Senior frontend engineer in Toronto, Canada, building AI-first products: generative UI,
> streaming AI responses to the interface, multi-tenant platform architecture, and Stripe billing
> systems in React and Next.js. Four years shipping React and React Native to production
> end to end. Came into engineering from four years of financial audit at KPMG, so
> comfortable in regulated, money-handling products. Open to senior frontend roles.

Contact: a.pirus2000@gmail.com | https://www.linkedin.com/in/anastasia-pirus | https://github.com/AnastasiiaPirus
Location: Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Currently remote with a US-based team.
CV (PDF): https://www.pirus.dev/files/anastasiia-pirus-resume.pdf

## Current role — Senior Frontend Developer, CreatorsAGI (Feb 2025 – present)

Envoy Studio, CreatorsAGI's platform for deploying configurable AI agents on clients' own domains.

- Architected the multi-tenant foundation: per-tenant authentication and onboarding with
  WorkOS AuthKit, tenant isolation, dynamic subdomain and custom-domain routing in Next.js,
  plus a reusable component SDK and design system for composing client-specific experiences.
- Built the generative-UI system at the core of the product: structured AI outputs become
  modular React components, streamed live to client sites over SSE.
- Shipped M'adrono (https://ai.talmido.org) end to end, prototype to production — an AI
  lesson-planning assistant live since September 2025, 25,000+ queries, ~850 monthly active users.
- Built the monetization layer: Stripe subscriptions and a usage-based credit system on
  Next.js and Supabase, with webhook-driven sync, credit ledgers, feature gating and a
  self-serve billing portal.
- Performance: cut LCP ~97% (~6.5s to under 200ms) across 25+ pages,
  and reduced response latency ~40%.

## Contract Software Developer — Independent (Apr 2022 – Feb 2025)

- FormKiQ (https://formkiq.com) — front end for an AWS-partnered document platform handling
  50M+ documents. React, TypeScript, Redux, Tailwind, React Flow drag-and-drop workflows.
- Royal Path — React Native app built and shipped end to end with gesture-based swipe
  interactions, animation and local state.
  https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.royalpath.voidverse
- Conscious (https://www.getconscious.online/) — Chrome extension that interrupts impulse
  purchases on Amazon and tracks money saved by walking away. Shopping data stays in the browser.

## Financial Statement Auditor — KPMG Canada, Baker Tilly Ukraine (Dec 2018 – Aug 2022)

Worked daily with sensitive client and financial data — the compliance, identity and risk
context that customer onboarding and verification flows are built on.

## Skills

AI / LLM: LLM integration, prompt engineering, agent tool calling, streaming AI responses to UI, generative UI, Google Gemini / Vertex AI, AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor).
Frontend: React, Next.js, React Native, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, MUI, design systems.
Backend & data: Node.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, GraphQL, REST APIs, Stripe (subscriptions
and webhooks), WorkOS AuthKit, Python, SQL.
Platform & practices: multi-tenant architecture, Vercel, Sentry, Playwright, CI/CD,
feature flags, Core Web Vitals, end-to-end testing.
